pages.title: Primordial Law
pages.text: The substance of law itself, before any particular law. It has no temperature and no fixed form, and it reshapes itself to fit whatever rule is asked of it. It is clear, cold and utterly still until disturbed.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Simulating the Tree and the Ocean in the Omnilex Engine, I found the simulations produced a residue that was neither matter nor energy, but rule. Primordial law, distilled from the simulation of law.

Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier, Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes I, Absolute Notes II, Absolute Notes III, Arbor Heartwood, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment and more.
